scanNote:
9-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (62-bet) - LEAD-IN. Butun bet TO'Q YaShIL fonda.

Chap yuqorida oq katta harflar 'UNIT 9'. O'rtada SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'A World of Wonders'.

BESh FOTO (A-E, yashil dumaloq belgili) - Wieliczka tuz koni:
 A - tuzdan o'yilgan haykallar guruhi: tiz cho'kkan erkak malikaga uzuk uzatmoqda, atrofda askar va xizmatkorlar
 B - tuz konida ikki konchi haykali, biri chiroq bilan
 C - yer osti ibodatxonasi (chapel): qandillar, o'yma devorlar, shaxmat taxtasidek pol
 D - yer osti ko'li, yog'och ko'priklar va odamlar
 E - ulkan tuz kristallari bilan g'or, o'tayotgan odam

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 'Choose the correct answers.'
   1 A SALT MINE is a place ... a where salt is dug out from below the surface of the ground. b under a house where salt is kept.
   2 A CHAMBER is ... a a big flat. b a big room.
   3 A CHAPEL is ... a a small tunnel. b a small church.
   4 A WELL is a hole in the ground from which we get ... a water. b salt.
   5 A MINER is someone who works underground ... a to construct chapels. b to get salt, coal, gold, etc.
   6 People who are DEEPLY RELIGIOUS ... a only work in mines. b believe strongly in a god or gods.

O'NG USTUN:
2) 'Pictures A - E show parts of the Wieliczka Salt Mine in Cracow, Poland. Which picture shows:' 1 statues carved from rock salt? 2 an underground lake? 3 a cave with huge salt crystals? 4 miners carrying salt up to the surface? 5 a chapel with beautiful carvings? (oq katakcha, nuqtali joylar)
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the statements, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).' 1 Near Cracow, in northern Poland, is the Wieliczka Salt Mine. 2 A king called the Blessed Kinga threw her ring into a salt mine. 3 The salt used to be dug out by hand. 4 A chapel was destroyed by fire in 1769. 5 A special attraction is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '62'.

exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT SO'ZLAR - TUZ KONI.

  a salt mine = tuz koni
  a chamber = katta xona (yer
     ostida)
  a chapel = kichik cherkov,
     ibodatxona
  a well = quduq
  a miner = konchi
  deeply religious = chuqur dindor


⚠ 'A MINE':

  = kon (yer osti).
  ⚠ 'mine' (olmosh) = meniki -
  boshqa so'z!
  ⚠ 'to mine' = kon qazimoq.


⚠ 'TO DIG OUT':

  = qazib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'is DUG out' - MAJHUL NISBAT
  (9-unit mavzusi!).
  ⚠ dig - dug - dug.


⚠ 'THE SURFACE':

  = yuza, sirt.
  ⚠ 'below the surface of the
  ground' = yer yuzasi ostida.


⚠ 'A CHAMBER':

  = katta xona, zal (rasmiy/eski).
  ⚠ 'chamber music' = kamer musiqa.


⚠ 'A CHAPEL':

  = kichik cherkov.
  ⚠ 'a church' - katta cherkov.


⚠ 'COAL':

  = ko'mir.
  ⚠ 'a coal mine' = ko'mir koni.


⚠ 'RELIGIOUS':

  = dindor.
  ⚠ 'religion' = din.
  ⚠ 'deeply' = chuqur (darajasi).

items.textEn: 1 A salt mine is a place ...
options: where salt is dug out from below the surface of the ground
under a house where salt is kept
items.answer: where salt is dug out from below the surface of the ground
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a mine' = kon - yer ostidan qazib olinadi.
⚠ 'is dug out' - majhul nisbat.

items.textEn: 4 A well is a hole in the ground from which we get ...
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a well' = quduq → suv.
⚠ 'well' (ravish) = yaxshi - boshqa so'z.

items.textEn: 5 A miner is someone who works underground ...
options: to get salt, coal, gold, etc.
items.answer: to get salt, coal, gold, etc.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a miner' = konchi - tuz, ko'mir, oltin
qaziydi.

options: believe strongly in a god or gods
items.answer: believe strongly in a god or gods
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'religious' = dindor → xudoga ishonadi.
⚠ 'to believe IN' - 'in' predlogi.

exercises.instructionEn: Pictures A - E show parts of the Wieliczka Salt Mine in Cracow, Poland. Which picture shows:
exercises.instructionUz: A-E suratlar Polshaning Krakov shahridagi Wieliczka tuz konining qismlarini ko'rsatadi. Qaysi surat ko'rsatadi:
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SURAT - BESh TAVSIF.

  1 statues carved from rock salt
    → A (haykallar guruhi)
  2 an underground lake → D (ko'l
    va ko'priklar)
  3 a cave with huge salt crystals
    → E (kristalli g'or)
  4 miners carrying salt up to the
    surface → B (konchilar)
  5 a chapel with beautiful
    carvings → C (qandilli
    ibodatxona)


⚠ 'WIELICZKA':

  Polshadagi mashhur tuz koni
  (XIII asrdan), YuNESKO ro'yxatida.
  ⚠ O'qilishi taxminan 'Velichka'.


⚠ 'CRACOW':

  = Krakov (Polsha janubidagi
  shahar).
  ⚠ Polyakcha 'Kraków'.


⚠ 'CARVED':

  = o'yilgan.
  ⚠ 'to carve' = o'ymoq (yog'och,
  tosh).
  ⚠ 'carvings' = o'ymakorlik.


⚠ 'ROCK SALT':

  = tosh tuz.


⚠ 'A CRYSTAL':

  = kristall.


⚠ 'UNDERGROUND':

  = yer osti(da).
  ⚠ 'the Underground' = London
  metrosi.

pairs.whyUz: ⚠ A - malika va tiz cho'kkan erkak haykallari.

pairs.left: 3 a cave with huge salt crystals
4 miners carrying salt up to the surface

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements, then listen and mark them as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK. Umumiy ma'lum
faktlar asosida ehtimoliy javoblar;
javoblar 63-betdagi matn bilan
tasdiqlanadi.


EhTIMOLIY JAVOBLAR:

  1 F - Krakov Polshaning JANUBIDA
      (northern EMAS)
  2 F - Kinga MALIKA (queen/
      princess), king EMAS
  3 T - tuz qo'lda qazilardi
  4 F - matnda 1697 (1769 EMAS)
  5 T - Muborak Kinga ibodatxonasi
      koning eng mashhur joyi


⚠ 'THE BLESSED KINGA':

  = Muborak Kinga - XIII asr
  Polsha malikasi (Vengriya
  malikasi), tuz koni afsonasi
  qahramoni: u uzugini Vengriyadagi
  tuz koniga tashlagan, keyin uzuk
  Wieliczkada tuz bilan topilgan.
  ⚠ 'blessed' = muborak, avliyo.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈblesɪd/ - ikki bo'g'in.


⚠ 'USED TO BE DUG':

  = qazilardi (o'tmishda odat +
  majhul nisbat).


⚠ 'BY HAND':

  = qo'lda.
  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ.


⚠ 'DESTROYED BY FIRE':

  = yong'inda vayron bo'lgan.
  ⚠ 'by' + sabab (majhul nisbat).

items.sentence: Near Cracow, in northern Poland, is the Wieliczka Salt Mine.
items.uz: Polsha shimolidagi Krakov yaqinida Wieliczka tuz koni joylashgan.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Krakov Polshaning JANUBIDA. Audio bilan
tekshiring.

items.sentence: A king called the Blessed Kinga threw her ring into a salt mine.
items.uz: Muborak Kinga ismli qirol uzugini tuz koniga tashladi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kinga - MALIKA ('her ring' - ayol), 'king'
EMAS. Audio bilan tekshiring.

items.sentence: The salt used to be dug out by hand.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Qadimda tuz qo'lda qazilardi. Audio bilan
tekshiring.

items.sentence: A chapel was destroyed by fire in 1769.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 63-betdagi matnda: 'destroyed by fire in 1697'
- 1769 EMAS! Raqamlar almashtirilgan.

items.sentence: A special attraction is the Chapel of the Blessed Kinga.
items.uz: Alohida diqqatga sazovor joy - Muborak Kinga ibodatxonasi.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kinga ibodatxonasi - koning eng mashhur joyi
(C-surat). Audio bilan tekshiring.
